name: WS2812B addressable LED strip (NeoPixel)
description: Chain of RGB LEDs controlled by one data pin. Set params.leds to the number of LEDs.
notes: Each LED draws up to 60 mA at full white: 30 LEDs = 1.8 A. Power the strip from a 5 V supply, not the microcontroller.
Add a 300-500 Ohm resistor in series with DIN and a 1000 uF capacitor across 5V/GND at the strip start (Adafruit best practices).
Datasheet VDD is 3.5-5.3 V; a 3.3 V data signal is below the 0.7 x VDD threshold at 5 V. It often works, but a 74AHCT125 makes it reliable.
Data flows one way: connect to DIN (arrows on the strip).

pins.name: 5V
pins.label: +5V
pins.note: Up to 60 mA per LED at full white (20 mA per colour).

pins.name: DIN
pins.label: DIN
pins.note: Data in. HIGH needs 0.7 x VDD (3.5 V at 5 V): a 3.3 V GPIO is out of spec; use a 74AHCT125 level shifter or power the first LED at about 4.3 V.

pins.name: DOUT
pins.label: DOUT
pins.note: Data out to the next strip.

geometry.note: Length depends on LED count and density (30/60/144 per metre).
